input.subject: Pocket listing DUMBO - screenshot attached
input.bodyText:
Quiet one in DUMBO, owner wants it off-market. Details in the screenshot. Co-broke, reply if you have a fit.

Tomas

attachments.parsedText: Screenshot of an internal listing card on a dark background. Header reads 'OFF-MARKET / POCKET'. Address line: '70 Washington St, Unit 9G, DUMBO, Brooklyn'. Beds/baths row: '3 BR | 2 BA | 1,420 sf'. Price in large green text: '$2,395,000'. Below: 'Condo, full-service, parking available, Manhattan Bridge views'. Footer: 'Do not advertise. Co-broke 2.5%. Tomas Herrera, Corcoran.'
